title: Microsoft Display Catalog API as Authoritative TR Price Source
context: Identifying the most accurate, authorized, and maintainable data source for Xbox Turkey prices.
decision: Use Microsoft Display Catalog API (displaycatalog.mp.microsoft.com/v7.0/products) as authoritative price and metadata source for TR market.
alternatives: Private Xbox live partner APIs with credentials
consequences: High stability, structured JSON response, batch support up to 25+ IDs
Zero token or session refresh maintenance
Safe rate limiter ensures long term resilience
risks: Undocumented rate limits require defensive collector delays and backoff.
